scenarios_version_parts.name: scenarios_version_parts
scenarios_version_parts.value:
("scenarios"."version_from" IS NULL) = ("scenarios"."version_from_parts" IS NULL)
        AND ("scenarios"."version_to" IS NULL) = ("scenarios"."version_to_parts" IS NULL)
        AND ("scenarios"."version_from_parts" IS NULL OR cardinality("scenarios"."version_from_parts") = 4)
        AND ("scenarios"."version_to_parts" IS NULL OR cardinality("scenarios"."version_to_parts") = 4)

scenarios_version_range.name: scenarios_version_range
scenarios_version_range.value: "scenarios"."version_from_parts" IS NULL OR "scenarios"."version_to_parts" IS NULL OR "scenarios"."version_from_parts" <= "scenarios"."version_to_parts"
